title: Titration Curve Analysis

actions.label: Insert the pH probe in the titration beaker

parameters.note: TIT-04: the bulb must be immersed and must not be struck by the stir bar. Calibration and rinsing rules stay teacher-configured (confirmation point 4).

interaction.successCue: The probe bulb is immersed in the analyte.
interaction.invalidCue: Charge the beaker with analyte before immersing the probe.

feedback.success: The probe bulb is immersed in the analyte.

actions.label: Read the initial pH

parameters.note: Read the meter with zero titrant delivered. The stability criterion is unresolved in the source (finding 4) and stays teacher-configured; the simulator does not model the pH, so the value you read is the value you record.

interaction.successCue: Initial pH read from the meter.
interaction.invalidCue: Immerse the probe before reading the meter.
interaction.accessibleLabel: Read the pH meter with zero titrant delivered.

stateChanges: Read the pH meter; reading and recording stay separate.

invalidCases.when: the probe is not in the analyte
invalidCases.message: A probe out of solution reports nothing meaningful.
invalidCases.recovery: Immerse the probe bulb, then read the meter.

feedback.success: Initial pH read from the meter.
feedback.invalid: Immerse the probe before reading the meter.

nodes.title: Observe pH paper
nodes.description: Record pH paper evidence for the acid and base.

feedback.retry: Review Observe pH paper and try again.

nodes.title: Measure analyte
nodes.description: Pour 25 mL of titration analyte into the graduated cylinder.

feedback.retry: Review Measure analyte and try again.

nodes.title: Transfer analyte
nodes.description: Pour the titration analyte into the beaker.

feedback.retry: Review Transfer analyte and try again.

nodes.title: Insert the pH probe
nodes.description: Immerse the probe bulb in the analyte, clear of the stirrer.

feedback.success: Insert the pH probe checkpoint passed.
feedback.retry: Immerse the probe bulb in the analyte, clear of the stirrer.

nodes.title: Read the initial pH
nodes.description: Read the meter with zero titrant delivered.

feedback.success: Read the initial pH checkpoint passed.
feedback.retry: Read the meter with zero titrant delivered.

nodes.title: Record initial pH
nodes.description: Record the initial pH of the analyte.

feedback.retry: Review Record initial pH and try again.

nodes.title: Mount the burette
nodes.description: Seat the burette in the ring-stand clamp so the stopcock is reachable and the tip clears the receiving vessel. Nothing may be delivered from a hand-held burette.

validation.label: Burette mounted on the ring stand.

feedback.retry: Clamp the burette to the ring stand before filling it.

nodes.title: Fill burette
nodes.description: Pour standard base into the burette.

feedback.retry: Review Fill burette and try again.

nodes.title: Read the initial burette level
nodes.description: Read the meniscus on the filled burette.

validation.label: Read the initial burette level completed.

feedback.success: Read the initial burette level checkpoint passed.
feedback.retry: Read the meniscus on the filled burette.

nodes.title: Deliver titrant
nodes.description: Pour titrant in measured portions while monitoring pH.

feedback.retry: Review Deliver titrant and try again.

nodes.title: Record equivalence volume
nodes.description: Record the equivalence-point volume from the titration curve.

feedback.retry: Review Record equivalence volume and try again.

nodes.title: Calculate molarity
nodes.description: Calculate unknown molarity from the equivalence-point volume.

feedback.retry: Review Calculate molarity and try again.
